formula: U = α(Task Success) - β(Resource Cost) - γ(Error Rate) - δ(Regression Penalty)

components.task_success: Percent of tasks/goals reaching complete within 50-tick post-deployment window
components.resource_cost: Normalized 0-1 inference time + KV cache usage vs sibling-module baseline average
components.error_rate: Fraction of sandbox/regression test runs that failed during proposal evaluation (pre-deployment)
components.regression_penalty: Scaled 0-1 from count/severity of post-deploy regression failures; single rollback-triggering event maps to 1.0

notes: Starting values for Phase 3; revisit after first real batch of ranked proposals.
